A [[Human/Legends|man]] named [[Rayt (civilian)|Rayt]] commandeered a '''speeder''' during a [[Battle of an unidentified planet|battle]] on a [[Unidentified war-torn planet|war-torn planet]]. Rayt, along with his friends [[Wes Apice|Wes]] and [[Bryn Apice]], used the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] to bypass a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] line of defense in order to gain access to an unprotected [[Bank/Legends|bank]]. The speeder was green in [[Color/Legends|color]].
